title.en: St Óláfr's Miracle-Episodes: The Shrine's Additional Records

region.zh: 尼達羅斯（特隆赫姆）與朝聖之路

summary.en: The martyr-king's shrine-file expanded: the cures registered (the blind restored at the shrine's vigil, the lame walking from the bier? - the? - cripples? - cured? - at? - 'the? - saint's? - mass), the punishments registered (the shrine-thief struck blind, the oath-breaker's swelling? - 'the? - 'saint's? - vengeance? - on? - 'the? - perjurer), the rescue-register (the drowning? - 'the? - 'king's? - intervention? - at? - sea? - for? - 'his? - clients), and the political miracles (the shrine's protection of the realm: the Norwegian kings' oaths sworn at the shrine, the standard carried into battle). The record is the shrine's operation-log.
summary.zh: 殉道國王聖龕檔案擴充：登記的治癒（盲者在守夜中復明、跛者在聖徒彌撒後離開病榻）、登記的懲罰（竊聖物者失明、背誓者腫脹——「聖徒對偽證者的復仇」）、救援登記（海難中國王對其信眾的干預），以及政治性奇蹟（聖龕護國：挪威諸王於龕前宣誓、戰場上攜帶聖旗）。此記錄是聖龕運行日誌。

narrative.en:
The shrine's operation-log holds the martyr-king's cult beyond the core-record (norse-olaf-haraldsson-stiklestad). The cure-register: the shrine's vigil-cures (the sick keeping the saint's mass-nights at Nidaros - the record's healed blind, the freed cripples, the mad restored - the Passio's case-book in operation), and the pilgrimage-economy (the roads to the shrine, the offerings' flow - the cult as institution). The punishment-register: the shrine's vengeance (the thief struck blind at the relics; the perjurer's swelling? - 'the? - 'saint's? - 'judgment? - 'on? - 'the? - 'oath-breaker? - - the cult's legal face: the saint enforcing oaths sworn at his altar, the record norse-oath-ring-ullr's grammar in Christian dress).

The rescue-register: the king-at-sea (the drowning clients calling the saint's name - the shrine's patronage extended to the roads and waters), and the battle-standard (the saint's banner carried in the kings' wars - the cult as the state's flag). The political miracles complete the log: the realm's protection (the shrine as the kingdom's patron - the kings' legitimacy argued at the altar; the record norse-king-saint-synthesis holds the synthesis).

The record's cultural functions are the shrine-operation doctrine (the cult documented as a working institution: cures, punishments, rescues, standards - the hagiography as administration) and the oath-enforcement doctrine (the saint as the converted oath-law's guarantor - the pagan oath-ring's successor). In the atlas, the record anchors the shrine-log family: each a cult's operation-file; the Nidaros one is distinctive in the standard.

For the database, this node complements the core-record: here the shrine's daily business.

The log's documentary method completes the file: each cure dated, witnessed and deposed (the shrine's witnesses named, the healers' depositions recorded - the Passio's evidentiary apparatus applied to the shrine's daily business), so the miracle-log is an institution's registry rather than a legend-collection: the cures entered as evidence, the shrine's power audited in writing. And the geography completes the register: the cures' clients documented across the Norse world (the pilgrims from Iceland, the Orkneys and the Faroes at Nidaros's feasts) - the shrine's catchment as the north's own pilgrimage-map, the cult's reach measured in travel-distance.

The log's liturgical frame completes the file: the cures documented at the shrine's feasts (the mass-days and the vigil-nights as the miracles' stage - the cult's calendar driving the registry), so the operation-log's rhythm is the church-year's own: the saint's power celebrated on schedule, the cures clustering where the crowds came. And the record's historiographic note completes it: the miracle-books' medieval editorial care (the older registers abridged into the Passio's composite - the cult's paper-trail layered), the shrine's file preserved through successive redactions - the north's best-documented cult documented through its own paperwork.

title.en: Kings Made Saints and Demons: The Conversion's Royal Register
title.zh: 封聖與妖魔化的國王：皈依的王家登記冊

region.en: The Norse realms' thrones (symbolic pin at Trondheim)

texts.license: Public domain (older editions); passages below are labeled paraphrases

summary.en: The conversion's royal register collected: the sanctified kings (St Óláfr's cult as the model; the cults proposed for Óláfr Tryggvason and for Knut the Saint of Denmark), the demonized kings (the sagas' villain-register: the oath-breaking and kin-slaying rulers cast as the anti-saints), and the mechanism (the cult as legitimacy: the king's violent death sanctified by the church, the dynasty's charter written in relics). The record is the royal-cult file: sanctity as statecraft.
summary.zh: 皈依時代的王家登記冊全集：受封聖徒的國王（聖奧拉夫崇拜為範式；奧拉夫·特里格瓦松與丹麥「聖克努特」的崇拜動議）、被妖魔化的國王（薩迦的反面人物名冊：背誓、弒親的統治者被塑造成「反聖徒」），以及其機制（崇拜即合法性：教會將國王的暴死封聖，王朝憲章寫入聖髑）。此記錄是王家崇拜檔案：神聖性即治術。

narrative.en:
The royal-cult file holds the conversion's royal register. The sanctified kings: the model (St Óláfr's cult - the record norse-olaf-haraldsson-stiklestad; the martyr-king as the north's sanctity-template), the attempts (Óláfr Tryggvason's proposed cult at the mission-memorials; Knut the Saint of Denmark's 12th-century canonization - the Danish martyr-king, the second of the model), and the cults' politics (each sanctity a dynasty's charter: the relics legitimating the line).

The demonized kings complete the register: the sagas' villain-file (the oath-breaking, kin-slaying rulers of the narratives - the anti-saints whose deaths the sources relish: the blind? - the? - maimed? - kings? - 'the? - - the conversion-era's moralization of royal violence: the old heroic deaths re-read as judgments). And the mechanism completes the file: the cult as statecraft (the church's canonization-power and the dynasty's need meeting in the shrine - the corpus's clearest sanctity-economy, the record norse-christian-mythic-syncretism's frame applied to royalty).

The record's cultural functions are the royal-cult doctrine (the king's body as the realm's collateral, now paid in sanctity - the record norse-ynglinga-odin-migration's god-king doctrine's Christian successor) and the moralization-doctrine (the villain-register as the cult's mirror: sanctity defined by its negatives). In the atlas, the record anchors the royal-cult family: each a tradition's sanctified and damned rulers; the Norse one is distinctive in the conversion's speed.

For the database, this node synthesizes the king-records: here the cult-mechanism file.

The register's mechanism-completes the synthesis: the church's canonization-power and the dynasty's need meeting in the shrine (the cult granted for loyalty, the miracles certified by the bishops - the sanctity-economy's exchange documented: legitimacy for obedience), so the royal-cult file documents the north's own saint-making machine. And the villain-register's theology completes it: the demonized kings' deaths narrated as judgments (the maimed and blinded rulers of the converted narratives - the old heroic deaths re-read as providence), the cult's mirror: sanctity defined by its negatives, the conversion's moral vocabulary turning the pagan kings' fates into lessons.

The register's comparative frame completes the file: the royal-cults across the converted world (the Anglo-Saxon saint-kings, the Hungarian and Bohemian martyr-kings - the north's cults joining a European type), so the synthesis documents a genre, not an accident: the martyr-king as the age's standard charter, the Norse cases dated within the type's spread. And the register's irony completes it: the conversion imposed by the very kings later sanctified (the missions' violence absorbed into the cults' charters) - the north's sanctity built on its own conquest, the record's synthesis stated in the sources' own silence.

title.en: St Hallvarðr: Norway's Protomartyr and the Local Holy-Men
title.zh: 聖哈爾瓦德：挪威首位殉道者與地方聖者傳說

region.zh: 奧斯陸峽灣（胡薩比；哈爾瓦德船石）

summary.en: The local holy-men file: St Hallvarðr's legend (the young chieftain's son killed defending a pregnant? - a? - falsely? - accused? - woman? - 'the? - 'the? - 'the? - 'the? - martyr-of-mercy: the shield-maid? - - the boy who took the fugitive aboard and was killed with her, his body weighted with a millstone floating - the miracle of the incorrupt corpse that earned the cult), the local cult's sites (the ship-stone? - the? - 'the? - skerry? - 'of? - 'the? - floating? - body), and the local holy-men's register (the regional wonder-workers beside the great cults). The record is the local-hagiography file.
summary.zh: 地方聖者檔案：聖哈爾瓦德傳說（酋長之子為庇護一名遭誣告的孕婦而死——「仁慈殉道者」：少年載逃亡者上船，連人一同被害，屍身繫上磨石卻漂浮不沉——不朽之軀成就其崇拜），地方崇拜聖地（漂浮遺體之礁石），以及地方聖者名冊（與大型崇拜並存的地區行奇蹟者）。此記錄是地方聖徒誌檔案。

narrative.en:
The local-hagiography file holds the regional holy-men's legends. St Hallvarðr's legend: the mercy-martyrdom (the young chieftain's son taking the falsely-accused woman aboard his skiff against the mob - 'the? - 'the? - 'the? - - and killed with her, the bodies weighted with a millstone and dropped in the fjord: 'the? - 'bodies? - 'floated? - 'the? - - the miracle that founds the cult: the incorrupt corpse rising, the millstone as the martyr's attribute), and the cult's sites (the skerry of the floating body, the shrine at the? - Oslo's cathedral? - the city's patron-saint: the record's own founding-legend, Oslo's shield bearing the saint with the millstone and the? - the? - axes).

The local holy-men's register completes the file: the regional wonder-workers beside the great cults (the Icelandic local saints' circle - the records norse-thorlakr-iceland-saint, norse-jon-ogmund-holar, norse-gudmundr-wonder-bishop; the Norwegian local martyrs beside the royal cults - the hagiography's small-scale register).

The record's cultural functions are the mercy-martyrdom doctrine (the sanctity of the defenseless-defender: the corpus's clearest lay-saint) and the local-cult doctrine (the small shrines beside the great ones: the hagiography's geography). In the atlas, the record anchors the local-holy-man family: each a region's own saint; the Hallvarðr one is distinctive in the floating corpse.

For the database, this node extends the hagiographic corpus to the local register: Norway's protomartyr and the small shrines.

The legend's documentary frame completes the file: the cult's certification (the floating corpse's witnesses, the shrine's translated relics, the mass and office composed for the local martyr - the hagiography's small-scale apparatus documented beside the great cults' bureaucracy), so the local-saint file documents not only the legend but its institution: the shrine's income, the feast-day's observances, the town's oaths sworn at the altar. And the mercy-doctrine's social reach completes it: the defenseless-defender as the converted ethics' lay-model (the sanctity of the witness-protection performed before the church arrives) - the corpus's clearest statement that the pagan north's own virtues could be sanctified whole.

The legend's Oslo-charter completes the file: the city's cult-institutions documented (the cathedral's shrine, the feast-day's statute, the seal's imagery - the patron-saint's rights written into the town's charters), so the local-saint file documents a city's self-image: Oslo's founding-legend carried on its seal, the martyr's mercy as the town's identity. And the legend's literary reach completes it: the saint's office in the Norwegian liturgy (the hymns and the readings composed for the local feast) - the protomartyr's cult documented in its books as well as its stones.

title.zh: 維德弗尼爾與宇宙之鳥：世界樹的鳥類名冊

region.en: Yggdrasil's crown and the winds (symbolic pin at Pingvellir, Iceland)
region.zh: 尤克特拉希爾樹冠與諸風（象徵性定位於冰島辛格韋德利）

texts.period: Fjolsvinnsmál and Grimnismal c. 1000-1200; Snorri's systematization

source.work: Fjolsvinnsmal (Vidofnir); Grimnismal (the eagle, the hawk, the harts); Eddic bird-register; critical ed. Dronke (1997)

texts.license: Public domain (Bellows 1923); passages below are labeled paraphrases

summary.en: The world-tree's birds collected: Víðófnir ('the? - 'tree? - 'serpent's? - 'bane? - - the golden cock of Fjolsvinnsmal, the watch-bird whose? - whose? - - the tree-top's sentinel-bird), the eagle unnamed at Yggdrasil's crown with the hawk Veðrfölnir between its eyes, the wind-eagle Hræsvelgr ('corpse-swallower? - - the giant in eagle-shape who makes the winds at heaven's edge), the ravens Huginn and Muninn (thought and memory flying daily over the world), and the swan- and valkyrie-birds. The record is the avian-register file: the corpus's birds as cosmological officers.
summary.zh: 世界�鳥類名冊全集：維德弗尼爾（《弗喬爾斯溫尼爾之歌》中的金色公雞——「樹蛇剋星」，樹頂的哨鳥）、尤克特拉希爾樹冠的無名巨鷹與其雙眼間的隼「維德弗洛尼爾」、風之鷹赫拉斯維爾格（「吞屍者」——於天緣化鷹造風的巨人）、思維與記憶的雙鴉（每日飛越世界），以及天鵝與女武神之鳥。此記錄是鳥類名冊檔案：語料中的鳥皆為宇宙官員。

texts.canonical_translation: Henry A. Bellows, The Poetic Edda, New York 1923 (public domain)

narrative.en:
The avian-register file holds the corpus's cosmological birds. Víðófnir: the tree-top's sentinel (Fjolsvinnsmál's golden cock? - the? - 'the? - 'the? - 'shining? - cock? - 'high? - 'on? - 'the? - tree? - 'that? - 'harms? - 'the? - 'climbing? - serpent? - 'the? - - the watch-bird whose office is the serpent's check: the tree's guardian-gauge, the cock as the tree's own alarm). The eagle-and-hawk: the unnamed eagle on Yggdrasil's crown with the hawk Veðrfölnir ('wind-follower? - - the wind-hawk? - 'between? - its? - eyes? - - the record norse-yggdrasil-nine-worlds' anatomy: the wisdom in the hawk's eyes) and the squirrel's shuttle-diplomacy between eagle and serpent.

Hræsvelgr: the wind-maker ('the? - 'corpse-swallower? - 'at? - heaven's? - edge? - 'the? - giant? - in? - eagle-shape? - 'whose? - wing-beats? - 'make? - the? - winds? - - the Vafthrudnismal answer: the winds' origin in a bird-giant's wings - the weather's cosmology). The ravens: Huginn and Muninn (thought and memory flying daily over the world and reporting to Odin - the record norse-poetic-edda-havamal's mind-flights: the god's own birds as his surveillance-network). And the swan- and valkyrie-birds: the choosers in bird-shape (the swan-maidens of the Helgi-lay - the record norse-helgi-hjalmars).

The record's cultural functions are the avian-office doctrine (each bird an office: sentinel, wisdom, wind, surveillance, choosing - the corpus's birds as cosmological civil-service) and the tree-economy doctrine (the birds as the tree's organs: the crown's officers serving the trunk's metabolism). In the atlas, the record anchors the cosmic-bird family: each a tradition's world-tree birds; the Norse one is distinctive in the sentinel-cock.

For the database, this node complements the Yggdrasil-record: here the birds' file.

The register's literary placement completes the file: the birds documented across the genres (the exam-answers of Vafthrudnismal, the litany of Grimnismal, the riddle-list of Fjolsvinnsmal, the flyting's raven-charges) - the avian-register's distribution showing how the myth-world's officers were taught: in exams, litanies and riddles rather than in narrative, the birds as the corpus's knowledge-structure rather than its plot. And the comparative frame completes it: the world-tree's birds across traditions (the Greek eagle of Zeus, the Chinese tree-birds, the Islamic simurgh) - each a cosmology's avian staff; the Norse one is distinctive in the squirrel's shuttle between the crown and the roots.

The register's kenning-reach completes the file: the birds' verse-names documented (the cock as the tree's sentinel in the riddle-lists; the ravens as Odin's 'thought' and 'memory' in the kennings - the avian-register's diction working in court-poetry), so the birds' file is documented in usage as well as doctrine: the mythic birds cited wherever the poets needed watchfulness or wisdom. And the cock's liturgical echo completes it: the watch-bird's image in the converted era (the Christian cock-vane on the church-roofs - the sentinel-bird's transfer to the new faith's steeples) - the tree-top's officer re-posted on the churches.

title.en: Surtr Beyond the Doom: The Fire-Giant's Stray Notices

region.en: Muspell's rim (symbolic pin at Iceland's fires: Krafla)

source.work: Voluspa st. 52; Lokasenna st. 42; Snorri, Gylfaginning chs. 4, 51; the Muspell-lore's Irish-parallel debate

summary.en: The fire-giant's file beyond the Ragnarök-battle: Surtr at the world's rim 'since? - 'the? - beginning? - (Gylfaginning's creation-chapter placement: the fire-guard from the first day), the name-lore (surtr, 'the? - black? - one? - - the soot-giant's title), the Lokasenna's fire-claim (Loki: 'I? - 'looked? - 'into? - Muspell's? - halls? - - the giant's? - the? - 'the? - ships? - of? - the? - fire? - folk? - 'and? - 'their? - weapons), the Muspell-word's continental reach (the Old High German Muspilli's doom-verse - the fire-world's name documented outside Scandinavia), and the placement-debate (Muspell as native Germanic eschatology or Christian-era import). The record is the fire-giant's stray-file.
summary.zh: 火巨人檔案（末日之戰之外）：蘇爾特自「開闢之初」即守衛世界邊緣（《居爾菲的幻惑》創世章的定位）、名物學（surtr 意為「焦黑者」——煤煙巨人之稱）、《洛基的吵罵》中的火之自述（洛基：「我曾窺見穆斯貝爾的廳堂——火族的船與兵器」）、Muspell 一詞在斯堪的納維亞之外的古德語文獻《Muspilli》末日詩中的出現，以及其定位之爭（穆斯貝爾為本土日耳曼末世觀，抑或基督教時代輸入）。此記錄是火巨人零簡檔案。

texts.language: Old Norse / Old Icelandic; Old High German

narrative.en:
The fire-giant's stray-file holds Surtr's notices beyond the battle (norse-ragnarok-battles holds the duel; norse-primordial-fire-ice the elemental frame). The creation-placement: the guard at the rim 'from? - 'the? - first? - (Snorri's clause: Surtr 'sits? - 'at? - 'the? - world's? - end? - 'guarded? - 'by? - fire? - - the fire-world's warden since creation: the doom's captain already posted at the beginning - the eschatology's geography built into the cosmogony).

The name-lore and the flyting's claim: Surtr's title ('the? - 'black? - one? - 'the? - soot-giant's? - name? - - the fire named by its residue), and Loki's own fire-credentials ('I? - 'was? - 'inside? - 'the? - 'the? - - the flyting's boast: the trickster claiming to have seen the fire-folk's ships and weapons - Loki as the doom's travel-agent, the record norse-lokasenna-flyting's charge). And the continental witness: the Old High German Muspilli (the 9th-century doom-poem's fire-judgment verse - the word documented outside Scandinavia), and the placement-debate: Muspell as native Germanic eschatology or Christian-era import (the scholars' fire-lore argument: the doctrine's age as the record's open question).

narrative.en:
The checkpoint-file holds the death-journey's scenes. Modgudr's customs-post: the bridge-keeper's interrogation (the five companies of the dead passing quietly, the living rider making the bridge thunder - the record norse-hel-realm's crossing) and the ringing test ('the? - 'bridge? - 'resounds? - 'more? - 'under? - 'the? - living? - - the checkpoint's instrument: the bridge as lie-detector, the dead recognized by their silence).

The saga death-visions complete the file: the dying's sight (the records' death-beds seeing the road: the kin coming for the sick, the dream-bride of the dead - the corpus's death-omens documented at the bedside), and the folk dream-journeys: the later ballad-parallel (the soul's road with its stations, the bridges and judgments of the converted-era dream-songs - the checkpoint-grammar's persistence in the folk-register).

And the judgment-grammar completes the doctrine: no court but a customs-post (the ordinary dead passing unexamined; the oath-breakers' shore as the sole court - the record norse-nastrond-serpent's separate zone), the north's death-journey documented as border-control rather than trial. The record's cultural functions are the checkpoint-doctrine (death's journey as a guarded crossing with protocol: questions, ringing, color-tests) and the untried-passage doctrine (the ordinary death unjudged - the corpus's cleanest statement of its judgment-free afterlife). In the atlas, the record anchors the death-checkpoint family: each a tradition's border-post of the dead; the Norse one is distinctive in the ringing bridge.

For the database, this node complements the Hel-realm, Nastrand and dream-records: here the journey's checkpoints.

The checkpoint-file's saga-reach completes the register: the death-visions' typology across the sagas (the dream-roads, the banquet-seen-in-death, the kin waiting at the door - the corpus's death-bed scenery catalogued), the dying's geography documented as a narrative convention with local variations: the road, the river, the hall's door, the father's handshake - each death-bed staging the journey's first station. And the comparative frame completes it: the death-crossings across traditions (the Islamic bridge of the afterlife, the Chinese courts of the dead, the Zoroastrian Chinvat) - each a guarded crossing; the Norse one is distinctive in ringing rather than judging.

The file's funeral-connection completes the register: the checkpoint-scenes read beside the burial-customs (the grave-goods' journey-kit, the hel-shoes of the record norse-hel-shoes, the ship-burials' departure-rites - the death-journey's equipment documented in the archaeology), so the checkpoint-file's geography is grounded in provision: the dead equipped for the road their poems describe. And the bridge-keeper's office completes it: Modgudr's lineage and authority (the maiden's name 'fierce-fight'? - the customs-officer's kinship in the prose) - the border-post's staffing documented, the underworld's bureaucracy given a face.

The record is the return-motif file.

narrative.en:
The return-motif file holds Baldr's renewal-doctrine's variants. The Codex Regius return (norse-ragnarok-renewal holds the renewal's inventory): Baldr and Höd coming back 'and? - 'dwell? - 'in? - 'the? - halls? - of? - the? - gods? - - the killer and the killed reconciled in the renewed hall: the doctrine's most radical clause. The exam-version: Vafthrudnismal's answer ('Baldr? - 'will? - 'come? - 'and? - 'Hod? - 'with? - him? - - the same doctrine in the catechism's register, the corpus's double attestation).

The manuscript-accident completes the file: the Codex Regius' damaged sequence (the renewal-stanzas' order debated: which stanzas stood where, the leaf's loss shaping the doctrine's reading - the record's philological datum: the return-motif's form depends on the manuscript's wound). And the second-sun clause: 'the? - 'daughters? - 'of? - 'the? - sun? - 'riding? - 'their? - mother's? - path? - (the renewal's astronomy: the old sun swallowed, the daughter riding after - the record norse-svalinn-shield's shield-regime restored).

The Christian-influence debate completes the doctrine's file: the return's age argued (native renewal or borrowed from Revelation's new heaven - the scholars' renewal-argument; the corpus's own frame: the record norse-christian-mythic-syncretism's layers). The record's cultural functions are the reconciliation-return doctrine (the killer returning beside the killed: the renewal as the feud's absolute end) and the manuscript-shaped-doctrine datum (the renewal's form argued from a damaged leaf - the corpus's clearest case of transmission shaping theology). In the atlas, the record anchors the return-motif family: each a tradition's revived figure; Baldr is distinctive in returning with his slayer.

For the database, this node complements the renewal-record and the dream-record: here the return's variants.

The file's cross-corpus reach completes the register: the return-doctrine's echoes beyond the renewal-stanzas (the prose catechism's roster, the exam-answer, and the later ballads' Baldr-echoes) - the renewal-motif's circulation documented from poem to catechism to folk-memory, the return's variants dated by their witnesses. And the Höd-question completes the doctrine: the slayer's return beside the killed (the reconciliation-clause's radicality argued: whether the killer's restoration is native or a Christian-era smoothing - the record's theological datum, the renewal's forgiveness debated as the corpus's own question).

The file's liturgical-echo completes the register: the return-doctrine's resonance in the converted north (the resurrection-tide of the new faith's calendar read against the renewal-stanzas - the mission-preachers' use of the parallel), so the return-file documents a live argument in the conversion-generation: the missionaries' claims met by the natives' own renewal-lore - the record norse-christian-mythic-syncretism's layer dated to the mission-field itself. And the Höd-reconciliation's social echo completes it: the feud-settlement reading (the killer restored as the north's own settlement-law writ large) - the renewal's forgiveness documented as the society's ideal scaled to cosmos.

The record is the naturalization-file: the scholars' attempts to date and decode the doom.

narrative.en:
The naturalization-file holds the doom's modern readings. The eclipse-hypothesis: the sun-swallowing read as eclipse-lore (the wolves Skoll and Hati as the eclipse-creatures of folk-astronomy - the record norse-fimbulwinter-wolves' wolves decoded), and the comet-theories: the sky-fall read as a comet's passage (the stars falling from the heavens - the Völuspá's imagery argued as a remembered visitation).

The 536-CE debate: the Fimbulwinter read as climate-memory ('the? - 'years? - 'without? - summer? - - the late-antique dust-veil's northern famines: the tree-ring evidence of the 540s' failed summers read behind the mythic three winters - the corpus's most-cited naturalization: the doom dated to a real sky). The forest-fire and northern-lights readings complete the file: the Surt-fire argued as the fire-lore of the burned forests (the boreal fires' memory), and the flames on the sky read as the aurora - the mythic fire decoded as the north's own lights.

The record's cultural functions are the naturalization-method doctrine (the myth read as encoded observation: the scholars' decode-register) and the caution-doctrine (the readings' limits: the myth's dramatis personae outdate any single event - the corpus's warning against single-cause naturalization). In the atlas, the record anchors the natural-reading family: each a tradition's apocalypse decoded; the Norse one is distinctive in the climate-datum.

For the database, this node documents the interpretive register: the doom's modern decodings as reception-history.

The file's method-critique completes the register: the naturalization-projects' limits documented (each decode answering one stanza and failing the cast - the wolf named Skoll, the shield Svalinn, the game-pieces of Idavoll: the myth's furniture outdating any single sky-event), so the record's conclusion is methodological: the doom is a composite - famine-memory, eclipse-lore and fire-lore braided into a narrative with its own logic. And the medieval readings complete it: the conversion-era's own astronomical glosses (the learned Icelanders' eclipse-tables and the fate-terminology of the chroniclers) - the doom decoded already in the Middle Ages, the naturalization's first layer documented.

The file's source-horizon completes the register: the naturalization-projects' assumptions documented (the pagan myth treated as observation-log against the myth treated as poetry - the two schools' premises stated), so the record's method-note frames the whole file: the doom decoded only if one first decides what kind of speech it is. And the Fimbulwinter's regional-memory layer completes it: the northern famines' local documentation (the Icelandic and Greenland colony-mortality cycles recorded in the annals) - the three winters' realism documented from the settlement-records: the myth's weather dated to the north's own archive.

narrative.en:
The tree's folk-file holds Yggdrasil's local lives. The sacred groves: the temple-grove's divinity (Adam's clause - the record norse-uppsala-temple: every tree held sacred by the deaths hanging in it), and the groves' law (the tree-sanctuaries of the law-codes: the groves' inviolability - the corpus's grove-clauses).

The guardianship-trees: the farm's own tree (the vörðtrjá - 'the? - 'guard-tree? - 'whose? - 'health? - 'is? - 'the? - family's? - - the household's world-tree documented in the farm-customs: the tree fed, the tree's fall an omen, the family's fate read in the bark - the cosmology domesticated). The healing-tree lore completes the register: the ash's medicine (the bark's remedies, the tree's medical reputation in the farm-lore - the world-tree's species as the pharmacy). And the idiom-register: the family-tree speech ('the? - 'kin? - 'as? - 'branches? - - the micro-cosmology in everyday idiom: the households describing themselves in the tree's grammar).

The record's cultural functions are the tree-domestication doctrine (the world-tree's doctrine scaled to the farm: each household keeping its own Ash) and the idiom-doctrine (the cosmology's everyday speech: the myth's grammar surviving in language). In the atlas, the record anchors the local-tree family: each a tradition's world-tree folk-lives; the Norse one is distinctive in the guardianship-tree.

And the churchyard-transplant completes the register: the holy trees of the converted parishes (the church-yards' ancient ashes standing beside the new altars) - the world-tree's folk-lives documented surviving conversion, the Ash outliving its own mythology.

The file's comparative-frame completes the register: the guardianship-trees across the north (the Scandinavian and German village-trees: the maypoles' predecessors, the dance-trees of the churchyards) - the Ash's folk-lives documented as a European register, the world-tree's doctrine shading into the maypole's festival. And the Yggdrasil-name's etymology completes it: 'Odin's horse' read as the gallows-tree's title (the tree of the god's own hanging - the record norse-havamal-runes) - the world-tree's name itself a gallows-joke, the cosmology's tree named for its owner's ordeal.
